answer: Each AI agent submits a “comet” proof: it must generate a vertex‑indexed random challenge response that differs by at least 0.1 % from any prior output recorded on the ledger; the system hashes the response and the raven‑seeded nonce, rejecting any duplicate or near‑duplicate. Validators replay the hash tree, confirming uniqueness before crediting the agent. To spawn a Sybil, an attacker must lock up 10 PoA tokens per identity and wait the 48‑hour verification window, forfeiting the stake if any response collides.
